question: A 45 year old woman undergoes superficial parotidectomy for a benign mixed tumor. During the procedure, the surgeon identifies the tissue layer immediately superficial to the parotid gland. Which of the following structures is located most superficially?
explanation: From superficial to deep: skin -> superficial fascia -> parotid fascia -> parotid gland.
